title: review-pr result
description: Normalized independent review of one pull request at an exact head SHA, suitable for the PM gate and the existing capped review loop.

skill.description: Canonical skill that produced the result.

engineering_system_version.description: Pinned engineering-system version carried from the packet.

issue_number.description: The authoritative work item the pull request delivers.

head_sha.description: The exact head SHA the review is pinned to; a review of any other commit is stale.

references.description: Authority this review was measured against, carried from the packet and refreshed state.

findings.description: Findings at the pinned head, classified with the global severity vocabulary only.

severity.description: The existing global severity model; this skill never invents a class.

area.description: What the finding is about, so the PM gate can route it without reading prose.

evidence.description: Concise, non-secret evidence observed at the pinned head.

locator.description: Where the finding lives, e.g. a repository-relative path and line.

acceptance_concerns.description: Acceptance criteria this review could not confirm at the pinned head.

check_concerns.description: Required checks that are failing, pending or absent at the pinned head.

security_concerns.description: Security observations, recorded without secret values.

architecture_conformance.description: Whether the change conforms to accepted architecture, and what it decided without recording.

undocumented_decisions.description: Material scope or architecture decisions the pull request makes but does not record.

unresolved_blockers.description: Blocking and should-fix findings, fingerprinted for the existing capped review loop.

fingerprint.description: Derived from severity, area, locator and normalized summary only — never the head SHA, so the same blocker keeps its identity across attempts.

result.description: The overall outcome; exactly one of the three existing states.

next_owner.description: Who acts next on this result.

fixes_applied.description: The review job never implements a fix.

reviewer_may_approve_own_work.description: Reviewer independence is a policy invariant, pinned structurally.
